description: This Java class 'BooleanInputsModel' manages input channels, including mapping channel numbers to display titles and labels indicating their boolean states. It provides methods to set channel values and retrieve descriptive labels for true/false states.

classes.name: BooleanInputsModel
classes.description: A model class that manages boolean input channels, their titles, and label texts for true/false states.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the formatted title string for a given channel, including its label if available.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the boolean value for a specific channel.

methods.name: getValueLabelText
methods.description: Returns the label text corresponding to the boolean value of a specific channel.
